action: Update detection compares local row counts to API counts; gaps in IDs and renames cannot be detected and equal counts hide drift.
backupCommand: git rev-parse HEAD > pre-fix-commit.txt && git diff --binary > pre-fix.patch  # reviewed source checkpoint
rollbackCommand: git revert <COMMIT_SHA> sau khi operator review; không force-push, không overwrite lịch sử.
validationCommand: npm run audit:typecheck && npm run test:audit && npm test && npm run build

action: Evolution stores only from/to IDs; triggers, levels, held items, friendship, time and version-specific conditions cannot be represented.
backupCommand: pg_dump -Fc --file="$BACKUP_PATH" "$AUDIT_DATABASE_URL"  # full logical backup, operator-approved staging/backup only
rollbackCommand: KHÔNG replay data-only SQL vào DB đã populate. Phục hồi full backup vào DB MỚI, verify counts/relations, rồi operator mới đổi connection; mọi thao tác cần phê duyệt.
validationCommand: npm run audit -- --db --out audit/reports/verify-db && npm run audit -- --offline --schema-only --out audit/reports/verify-schema
